2645-3147-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Azorius Chancery's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

1456-4785-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-4063.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

833-907-1059-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-907-1059-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Selesnya Sanctuary, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3259-6968-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4681-5256-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4716-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4716-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1869-3839-4214.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
The token Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Hero.
The nontoken Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Hero trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Utopia Mycon by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Hero token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2713-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2713-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2374-2841-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1680-4321-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Food and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3602--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-3602--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3525-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3525-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

2084-6472.notablePrerequisites: Deceptive Frostkite is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-6472.description: Activate Deceptive Frostkite by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Deceptive Frostkite into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

465-3480-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3480-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1129-3525.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Harabaz Druid.
1129-3525.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1129-3525.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat

147-1223-2292.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-2292.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 that many times.

2981-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
2981-5365-5366.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-2366-3346-4147-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
"Mercenary" chosen with Rukarumel.
1636-2366-3346-4147-4452.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}.

Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Heat Shimmer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

939-3129-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1385-2018-4050-5197.description:
Activate Downdraft by paying {G}, causing Luminous Broodmoth to lose flying until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth, adding {G}.
Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

2882-4675-4694-4808.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-4808.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Black Lotus enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2757-4762.notablePrerequisites: An additional untapped basic land under your control.
628-2757-4762.description:
Tap Druid for {G}.
Untap Druid using her own ability, adding -1/-1 to her.
Do this until she dies.
Mikaeus triggers, returning Druid with a +1/+1 counter.
Druid is summoning sick.
Tap a basic land floating mana.
Tap Druid with Earthcraft to untap the land.
Untap Druid with her own ability.
Do this until Druid dies.
